title: Aapke aane ke baad
body:
Aapke aane ke baad
Mojiza ek ye bhi hoga aapke aane ke baad
Dhoop ban jaegi saaya aapke aane ke baad
Aapke ke aane se pehle maut hai ye zindagi
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi khud hogi zinda aapke aane ke baad
Husn per Yusuf ke jab wo aaj tak hairaan hai
marr hi jaegi Zulekha aapke aane ke baad
Khud hi ho jaunga hazir aapke darbar me
<<DIVIDER>>
mai na lunga istekhara aapke aane ke baad
Kaun rokega bhala tameer karne se hame
Fatima Zehra (sa) ka roza aapke aane ke baad
Kitni batein madhe Haider ki abhi seene me hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jinhe zahir karunga aapke aane ke baad
Hum to kya hai aapke dushman se khud legi zameen
aapke jaane ka badla aapke aane ke baad
Wo NAMAZI wo NUSAIRI or wo hai MATAMI
<<DIVIDER>>
khatm hoga bus ye jhagda aapke aane ke baad
Keh rahe hai jo tamasha Matam e Shabbir ko
khud banengey wo tamasha aapke aane ke baad
Aapka darbari shayar sab Takallum ko kahe
<<DIVIDER>>
kaash mil jaye ye rutba aapke aane k baad
Aapke aane k baad..
author: Mir Hassan Mir
